notes.title: The release date is the 15th of November
notes.notes:
Exciting Update!

We are thrilled to reveal our final release date! This journey has been quite the adventure, with countless efforts poured into creating the finest game imaginable. During our Early Access phase, we've explored new mechanics, listened to your invaluable feedback, and enhanced Buildest. Our hope is that you'll be happy with the result.

Get ready for:
[list]
[*]A whopping 46 pre-made levels campaign
[*]Local and online co-op
[*]Steam Remote Play support
[*]A creative mode
[*]A level editor with Steam Workshop integration
[*]Enhanced settings customization for a comfortable gameplay
[*]And a myriad of other delightful tweaks and improvements designed to make Buildest even better
[/list]

Mark your calendars for November 15th, and let's meet on the construction site!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40001430/0caa7ce462a042a25604f5ea3fdd039b77392b2c.gif[/img]

notes.title: Local co-op and sandbox update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The b_0.6.013 update is here!

We're here with some significant news about an update that we've been diligently working on. Let's talk about the key features:

[list]
[*][b]Local Multiplayer[/b]: In response to your requests, we've added local multiplayer to our game. You can now enjoy Buildest with friends on a single computer using up to four controllers. We've made sure to optimize this experience for comfort and enjoyment.

[*][b]Remote Play[/b]: For those who prefer to game from different PCs, we enabled the Remote Play Steam feature. Connect with your friends and play online.  

[*][b]Sandbox[/b]: Buildest is finaly architecture playground. You'll have the freedom to craft your buildings, design levels with personalized level objectives, and even construct entire gaming campaigns. This extends to recreating all 46 levels from scratch, offering endless creative possibilities.

[*][b]Steam Workshop Support[/b]: Sharing your creations or exploring others' designs is now made effortless through Steam Workshop integration. Dive into a pool of user-generated content and discover fresh perspectives on gameplay and design.

[*][b]Alternative Camera and Settings[/b]: A new camera option with adjustable speed has been added for a refined viewing experience. Additionally, we've expanded the settings menu, providing more options for fine-tuning your gameplay environment.

[*][b]Bug Fixes and Polish[/b]: We've dedicated time to addressing various issues and applying polishing touches across the game.
[/list]


We greatly value your involvement and input, which have played a crucial role in refining the Buildest experience. We're genuinely excited to share this progress with you. 

Happy constructing!

Pavel Arkhipov and Olga Arkhipova

notes.title: Update b_0.6.010
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! In the b_0.6.010 update, we have:

[list]
[*]added the ability to customize keyboard controls! Some players complained about inconvenient controls, and now you can customize them to your liking - for example, move with WASD or build with Num5 - choose the keys that suit you best!
[*]slightly changed the tutorial, based on your gameplay experience
[*] changed the logic of selection movement in project mode - now the wall selection moves in a circular manner
[*] fixed a bug with connecting 5+ players, animation freeze of builders, and a few other minor bugs
[/list]

We are starting to work on adding the main features - sandbox mode and local multiplayer, and continue to listen to your feedback. If you have any comments and suggestions on how to improve Buildest, we would be happy to hear them on [url=https://discord.com/invite/NFSvahznVJ]our Discord channel[/url].

Thanks to all our players,
Pasha and Olya

notes.title: First week update b_0.6.009
notes.notes:
Hello everyone 
We've been collecting feedback from you all week, trying to fix as many bugs as possible and make as many improvements to the gameplay as possible. Here's what we managed to do:
[list]
[*] The main news is that going up the floors now happens automatically! You don't need to take any action to climb to a new construction level, but you can still use the same buttons to go down below if you want to
[*] We have added hints in the lower right corner of the screen explaining which button activates which action. We sincerely hope that this will make the game process more convenient, especially for beginners
[*] Fixed a bug with not exiting the download mode after completing a level. In some cases, this bug led to the disconnect of the cooperative game, now this will not happen
[*] The time for reconstruction of the trajectory of the builders' movement after the demolition of the wall was shortened
[*] We blocked the main menu control for the second player
[/list]

Unfortunately, the problem with connecting players from the USA turned out to be bigger than we thought. As it turned out, the company that owns the servers that provide us with a multiplayer game does not have the ability to automatically connect players who are far from each other and connect to different servers - unfortunately, we did not even suspect this. This problem only concerns players from different parts of the world, for example, the USA-Europe or Asia-South America. We are very sorry if you encounter any inconvenience because of this. To date, this problem remains unresolved, but we will do everything possible to eliminate it.

Also among the plans for the near future is to improve the tutorial and fix some bugs with animations and builders getting stuck.
If you have comments, ideas or suggestions on how to improve Buildest - we will be very happy to hear them in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/NFSvahznVJ]discord channel[/url]! We are happy to continue working on the game together with the community and are grateful to everyone who gives us their feedback. Together we will make Buildest even better!

Thanks to all our players,
Pavel and Olga.

notes.title: Buildest release in early access on March 24
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

First of all, thank you for your patience! The delay was long but very productive for us. All of this time we were thinking about how to improve gameflow, we were adding new content, and trying our best to make fun cooperative mode. We hope that you are excited to see the results of our work. 

So, Buildest will be released on the 24th of March this year in early access. The game is almost finished, there are only two things that it lacks: sandbox mode and your feedback. Yes, we added 3 more historical eras, redone the tutorial, set up multiplayer, and worked on feedback after beta tests. However, we still think that together we can make Buldest even better. 

If you want to participate in the development of the game, find friends to play cooperative mode or just share your creations, hop on our discord server: https://discord.gg/NFSvahznVJ . Besides that, we are planning to give away some keys there just before the release.

Only two people are working on the project, and we are excited by your interest. Thank you so much for your support!

notes.title: We are delaying Buildest release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Unfortunately we have to reschedule Buildest release date due to latest events in Ukraine. We hope that this tremendous disaster will end as soon as possible. 

Work on the game is not frozen. We are going to continue work on new content for Builders very soon. We will let you know about any updates and future announces. So, stay tuned.

We are very sorry for the delay and hope for the best.

notes.title: Buildest release in early access on March 25
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

Thank you so much for all of your support and patience! We are very happy to see your positive reaction to our game. Buildest is our passion project, and we are thrilled that you are enjoying it too. 

We want to make Buildest in the best way possible. So we decided to launch [b]an early access on March 25[/b]! It will help us to polish game more efficiently and will give you the possibility to influence the development process. Feel free to let us know what you want to see in Buildest. New architecture styles, new features or game modes, we want to know your ideas.

So, the first early access build will contain 4 historical eras and 6 levels inside of each era. Cooperative mode will be added later during the early access. Final version will have 3 new eras and sandbox mode. Actually we prepared a lot more features for the final release, so stay tuned for future announcements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40001430/a9e12b44a208a811f6ef852230aefb75f949eb10.png[/img]

[i]Will see you on the construction site![/i]
